category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Backups of information are conducted, maintained, and tested.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CP-9 (System Backup), CP-4 (Contingency Plan Testing)
implementation_examples: Conduct, maintain, and test backups of personal-data systems on a defined cadence
Align backup retention with the documented data retention policy
Capture restorability evidence (test restores) and corrective actions as needed
assessment_objectives: Determine whether backups are performed on a defined cadence
Determine whether restorability is tested and evidenced
Determine whether backup retention aligns with data retention policy
Determine whether backup storage is secured against unauthorised access
